1. (Currently Amended) A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more __3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS)-modified__ polyisocyanates __derived from__ aliphatic diisocyanates.

2. (Currently Amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two __different__ OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently Amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein the aliphatic diisocyanate __used to derive component B)__ is 1,6-diisocyanatohexane.

5. (Previously presented) A method of producing a cleanable coating on a substrate comprising applying the dispersion of claim 1 to the substrate and curing the coating composition.

6. (Previously presented) A coating produced according to the method of claim 5.

7. (Currently Amended) The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm __and the coating exhibits improved cleanability__.

8. (Currently Amended) The coating of claim 7, wherein the __root mean square__ surface roughness of the coating is greater than 200 nm.
